_summary: scope_manifest.json is semantically identical to shared/scope_manifest_template.json (the JSON diff is empty): every field is empty or a template placeholder. Stage 2 Scope Lock-In therefore FAILS checks 2, 3, 6, 7 and 8. Checks 4 and 5 pass only because there is nothing to check, and there is nothing to lock in. The premise 'verify-only, no builder step' does not hold: the manifest must be built (artifact-builder) from the sealed MANDATE, the build-manifest and the CCG before Stage 2 can pass. Separately from the empty file, the scope sources were checked against each other. The CCG counts are right: 13 modules m01..m13, 53 annexes = FED + MULTI + 51, and C40 has 18/18 rows answered. The tier verdict is byte-identical in build-manifest, MANDATE, SKELETON-MANIFEST and CCG m01, and so are the 21 domain tiers. The contractor / 1099-NEC exclusion [US-OWN-008] reads the same in MANDATE line 22, build-manifest _scope.workers, the CCG front matter, m01 1.0, m06 T57r5, annex FED and 32 annexes (MD..WY). Two build-manifest scope strings were stale against the sealed MANDATE and were fixed in place, and the oracle register ids gained US-FED-027. Still open: three scope-wording drifts (the bare annex rows in AL..CT; the US-OWN-005 deferral missing from CCG m11.3 and m01; the open owner flag on prevailing wage in US-MQ-07) and an under-filled consumed_by on US-OWN-008.

Stage 2 checks: 1 PASS, 2 FAIL, 3 FAIL, 4 and 5 pass only because there is nothing to check, 6 FAIL (F9-F15 missing), 7 FAIL, 8 FAIL. The template placeholders are residual markers (C29). Nothing is locked in, so every downstream stage (RSPEC C18/C44, WTC, DD, SIR) would read an empty scope.

findings.problem: The sealed mandate says 'prevailing wage OUT OF SCOPE except as an optional flag for covered public-works contracts (owner to confirm the flag)'. No US-OWN row records that confirmation, and the CCG does not carry the out-of-scope tag. Instead it models prevailing wage as an in-scope overlay with facts: m04 'Prevailing-wage overlay' (Davis-Bacon USD 2,000, weekly certified payroll [US-FEDS5-027]), m10 10.1 (certified payroll on public works, CA eCPR), FED.10 and every annex section 10 (e.g. tn.prevailing_wage.unskilled_laborer.hourly 23.52). The scope of prevailing wage is therefore undecided, and MANDATE and CCG word it differently. Stage 2 cannot lock it.
